gen-gf-metamorphous-fs-merriweather-sans: Metamorphous has generous space around every letter and a soft shift between its fat and slim strokes, never fragile even where thin. Merriweather Sans, a plain sans, stays sturdy beneath.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-archivo: Tube-straight and loud, with a splayed c. Tilt Neon does the shouting with its constant-width stroke, while Archivo handles the talking, its curves opening outward and its tall x-height easy on the eye.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-fs-asap: Commanding tubes of constant width give Tilt Neon its muscle, with curves that show no stress at all. Asap follows with open arcs and a body height close to the capitals.
gen-gf-paprika-general-sans: Expressive and scattered, Paprika spaces its lowercase out so the letters fill the line like capitals. General Sans takes over with steady pen pressure and a smooth path around every bend.
gen-gf-revalia-manrope: Manrope keeps a pen line of one width and bright open mouths on its curves, leaving Revalia's wide, relaxed stride to do the shouting. Both stay generous with space.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-montserrat: Stencil cut, with wide bridges between letters and tall lowercase that looks sprung from a sheet. Montserrat glides beneath it on generous white space, wire-smooth.
gen-gf-tektur-satoshi: Tektur brings pipe-cleaner strokes and oversized lowercase, every curve left generously open. And Satoshi, with its soaring x-height and single stroke width, gives that energy somewhere to rest.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-fs-epilogue: Tilt Neon draws its tube-like strokes at constant width, with a splayed c and short ascenders. But Epilogue loosens up beside it, curvy and wire-thin, a tall-bodied lowercase with stubby ascender tips.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-scope-one: Tall lowercase locked together like fine chain links. New Title is the bold, modern voice here, while Scope One brings a traditional, refined body with counters spilling open.
gen-audiowide-switzer: Switzer reads tall and wire-like, its c tips keeping a polite distance. Audiowide adds futuristic, tile-like glyphs with wide grout lines, and that clash of rigid and relaxed is the pair's strongest quality.
